title: Stat Editor
script:
----------------------------------------------------------------------
--Defaults
--Power-0.5, Speed-16, MaxHp-100, HPRegen-0.3333333
----------------------------------------------------------------------
--Configs
----------------------------------------------------------------------
getgenv().Class = "Class1" -- Set Whatever Host you want here.

Power = 0.5 -- This is your power multiplier, Each .5 is a x1.5 multiplier
Speed = 16 -- This is your movement speed, Each number accounts for 3% of your walkspeed
MaxHp = 100 -- This is how much HP you're limited to
HPRegen = 0.3333333 -- This is how fast you regen HP
----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The loadstring
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NICKISBAD/HOURS-test/main/HOURS%20Stat%20Editor"))()
